axioms_minimal.CCM_2007_A1_A6: Chamseddine-Connes-Marcolli 2007 axioms A1..A6 for the spectral Standard Model: A1 (real spectral triple), A2 (KO-dim=6), A3 (first-order condition), A4 (orientability), A5 (Poincare duality), A6 (regularity / smooth dimension).
axioms_minimal.KO_dim_6: KO-dimension of the finite spectral triple equals 6 mod 8
axioms_minimal.A_F_singleton: Finite-dimensional algebra A_F = C (+) H (+) M_3(C); singleton result of the d=12 admissibility lattice (S83 G32).
axioms_minimal.Mellin_kernel: Spectral action S_b = Tr f(D^2/Lambda^2) expanded via Mellin transform giving Seeley-DeWitt expansion S = f_4 Lambda^4 a_0 + f_2 Lambda^2 a_2 + f_0 a_4 + ...

step_1.claim: The Goldstone phi field arises as a phononic excitation of the spectral fabric — a U(1) phase mode on the SU(2) sector of A_F.
step_1.source_detail: A_F = C (+) H (+) M_3(C) gives a U(1) from C, an SU(2) from H, and an SU(3) from M_3. The Goldstone phase is the U(1) zero mode; its existence requires no auxiliary input.

step_2.claim: The two-point Goldstone correlator at scales below the fold has an Ornstein-Zernike (single-pole) structure: P(K) = T / (J*K^2 + m^2), where J is a stiffness and m is the bare mass.
step_2.source_detail: The Mellin-kernel expansion of the spectral action gives a Klein-Gordon kinetic term (a_2 coefficient of Seeley-DeWitt) and a mass term. For a single Goldstone (one species, one pole) the propagator IS O-Z by construction. Multi-pole structure would require auxiliary fields beyond the singleton A_F.

step_3.claim: The spectral tilt: n_s(K) - 1 = d ln P / d ln K = -2/(1+u), where u := m^2 / (J*K^2).
step_3.source_detail: Pure algebraic consequence of the O-Z propagator form; uses only logarithmic differentiation. No auxiliary input.

step_4.claim: The running: alpha_s = d n_s / d ln K = -4u/(1+u)^2.
step_4.source_detail: Algebraic consequence of (E1); second logarithmic derivative of the O-Z propagator. No auxiliary input.

step_5.claim: (n_s - 1)(n_s + 1) = (-2/(1+u))(2u/(1+u)) = -4u/(1+u)^2 = alpha_s. Hence alpha_s = n_s^2 - 1 IDENTICALLY for any K, m, J, T.
step_5.source_detail: Algebraic identity. The variable u is eliminated; the final form depends ONLY on n_s, not on K, m, J, T. No observational input required; the identity is functional, not numerical.

step_6.source_detail: This step inserts an OBSERVATIONAL n_s (Planck) to obtain a NUMERICAL prediction. The identity alpha_s = n_s^2 - 1 itself did NOT use this n_s; the evaluation is downstream of the derivation. Per audit definition (plan §W10b-123), this is a post-derivation evaluation, NOT an axiom or aux-coupling input in the derivation chain.

observational_inputs_used_in_evaluation: Planck n_s = 0.9649 (used ONLY for downstream numerical evaluation, NOT in the derivation chain itself)

cross_check_b_substrate.method: exact O-Z alpha_s = -4u/(1+u)^2 vs identity at n_s=0.9649

cross_check_c_functional.method: evaluate identity at 5 n_s values in scan

cross_check_d_cc5.method: CC-5 propagation alpha_{n_s^2} = 2 n_s alpha_s vs functional

verdict_reason: derivation closes under {CCM + KO-dim=6 + A_F-singleton + Mellin-kernel}; no auxiliary couplings; no observational n_s in derivation; all 4 cross-checks pass
